summary.text: Jack Flanagan is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 45, where he assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House for Hillsborough 26 and works in insurance.

paragraphs.text: Jack Flanagan earned a bachelor's degree from Boston University and a graduate degree from Southern NH University.
He has served on his local school board and select board, and his career experience includes working in insurance.
Flanagan served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 26 from 2010 to 2016 and from 2018 to 2020.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed his key messages as controlled spending and a focus on constituents.
He said he is passionate about local control on housing issues.
